growth_form_policy.applies_to: 23 roster entries and 24 individual profiles including Brio; the original core is 22 entries and 23 profiles, with F1 Navi and F2 Mote separate.
growth_form_policy.progression_threshold: Existing ADR0013 derives Base at 0–4 adventures and Grown from five; this art reconciliation does not change earning, receipts, ownership or backups.

counts.scope_note: Original-core counts refer only to package 2.9. Brio is a separately preserved 24th profile; legacy source boards and superseded review assets are retained without adding active masters.

reference_rules: Keep character identity, visual form, art revision, expression set, animation rig and application binding separate.
A newer generated image never replaces a selected reference without a user decision.
Use approved_art_reference only with an exact selected artifact. Keep selected_exact_asset_pending explicit until that artifact is recovered.
Base identity anchors constrain base edits; mature architecture may deliberately change. Do not overwrite base specifications.
F is one roster entry containing F1 Navi and F2 Mote. Do not invent acquisition, ownership or runtime mapping semantics.
Single-character mature production profiles contain one character. Multi-character source boards are references, not final isolated assets.

Only two visual growth stages exist: Base (forms.base) and Grown (forms.mature). Preserve ADR0013 earned-progress compatibility and existing saved data; expressions and revisions do not create an intermediate form.
Retain superseded artwork and reasons; do not delete revision history.
